fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: The hourly check that starts tests when they're due. Off: saving removes its timer; running tests finish. On: saving puts the timer back.

fields.label: UniFi OS account
fields.help: Account the tests run as. Empty = the console owner, which needs no setup. Another account must be an admin with UniFi Drive management rights.

groups.title: How often each drive gets an extended test

fields.label: Healthy drive
fields.help: Days between tests on a healthy drive.

fields.label: Drive with warning signs
fields.help: Days between tests on a drive with warning signs: a watched count that rose and has had no clean test since, a UniFi risk reason, or a UniFi state other than optimal.

fields.label: Old drive
fields.help: Days between tests on a drive older than the old-drive age below.

fields.label: Old-drive age
fields.help: Power-on hours after which a drive counts as old and gets the old-drive interval. 43800 h is about 5 years.

fields.label: Retry after a failure
fields.help: After a test fails or is aborted, smart-scheduler alerts and tests that drive again this many days later.

fields.label: Warning attributes
fields.help: SMART attributes to watch. A rise since the last test makes that drive due at once; a count that stays the same is ignored.

fields.label: Per-drive intervals
fields.help: Intervals for single drives, by serial number.

fields.label: Never test
fields.help: Drives to never test, by serial number.

fields.label: Start window
fields.help: Local time (the NAS's timezone). May cross midnight, e.g. 22:00-04:00.

fields.label: Tests at once
fields.help: Never run more than this many tests at once.

fields.label: Starts per night
fields.help: How many tests the hourly check may start in one night. 0: none start, and running tests finish; set it above 0 to start them again.

fields.label: Scrub margin
fields.help: Don't start a test that could still be running this many hours before a scheduled scrub.

fields.label: Duration factor
fields.help: A test's length is the drive's own estimate times this.

fields.label: Busy drive above
fields.help: The hourly check skips a drive busier than this (read + write) when a test would start. 0: drives are never skipped for being busy.

fields.label: Avoid backup tasks
fields.help: Keep tests clear of UniFi Drive's scheduled backup and replication tasks. Only schedules and run times are read, never credentials.

fields.label: Backup margin
fields.help: Don't start a test that could still be running this many hours before a task starts, or until this long after its estimated end.

fields.label: Default backup length
fields.help: How long a task with no run history is assumed to take.

fields.label: Upload speed
fields.help: Upload speed to the backup provider, used with no run history when the task has no bandwidth limit. 0 = unknown.

groups.title: Heartbeat
groups.help: Empty: the shared heartbeat URLs in Notifications are used.

fields.label: Own heartbeat URL
fields.help: Pinged after every hourly check that ends without errors, so this tool has its own check (an hourly period) apart from the others.

fields.label: Own heartbeat URL on failure
fields.help: Pinged instead when the hourly check ends with errors. Used only with the own heartbeat URL.
